findings.claim: CreateColumnBatchHandler mints an id for any member that omits one (`const id = (c.id ?? createId('column'))`), and the CEB batch fan-out reads the id from the PAYLOAD and skips id-less members with a bare `continue` -- no console, no counter, no refusal. A batch of N columns whose members carry no id commits N columns to the plugin store and produces ZERO column.created events, so zero legacy records, zero meshes, zero plan symbols and zero persistence. This is the FIX-BEAM-ID / FIX-CW-ID class, still live in the batch arm, and unlike the beam batch's geometry check it is not even loud.
